title: Psalm 8
firstLine: O Lord, our Lord, in all the earth how excellent Thy name! Thou hast Thy glory spread afar upon the starry frame.

lines: O Lord, our Lord, in all the earth how excellent Thy name! Thou hast Thy glory spread afar upon the starry frame.
When I regard the heav'ns above which Thine own fingers framed, and look upon the moon and stars which were by Thee ordained.
O what is man, that Thou dost him within thy thought retain? Or what the son of man, that Thou to visit him dost deign.
For Thou a little lower than the angels made; a crown of glory and renown hast placed upon his head.
Thou set him lord o'er all Thy works; beneath him all things be; all flocks and herds, all beasts and birds, and fishes of the sea.
And what-so-ever living thing the paths of ocean claim. O Lord, our Lord, in all the earth -- How very excellent Thy name!
